description: Defines the srs_resource_configuration structure and related enums and nested structs for configuring Sounding Reference Signals (SRS) in 3GPP NR (5G) specifications, including parameters for periodicity, antenna ports, symbols, bandwidth, and hopping.

classes.name: srs_resource_configuration
classes.description: Structure holding parameters for SRS resource configuration as per 3GPP specifications.

methods.name: has_frequency_hopping
methods.description: Checks if frequency hopping is enabled based on current parameters.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Validates the combination of resource parameters for correctness.
